title: Argentinian Stew with Lush Greens
description: A hearty stew from Argentina, featuring lush greens and tender beef, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Lush greens (such as kale or collard greens)
Argentinian beef (such as flank steak or skirt steak)

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ume paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil. Return the beef to the pot and cover.
Transfer to the oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Add the chopped greens to the pot and cook until wilted, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
